name: Operation command center
capability: Shared operations state and a human control surface for canonical resources, connected services, observed fleet sessions, budgets, tool calls and reversible feed housekeeping. The same state is available through existing shared-equipment carriers.
next_gap: Only schemas reported by a live registered gateway are callable there. Provider metadata, reported VM capacity and current operational outcomes remain distinct. Model drivers use the existing APIs; this interface does not create an autonomous model loop.
